title: Senior 2D & 3D Interior Designer
description:
**Position:** Senior 2D \& 3D Designer\& Supervisor  
**Company:** JJ Studio by Deepa Bagaria

JJ Studio by Deepa Bagaria is looking for an experienced **Senior 2D \& 3D Designer** to join our team.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum **3 years of experience** in an interior design firm.
* Completed **Interior Designing course** from a recognized institute.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD** for detailed working drawings.
* Strong knowledge of **SketchUp**, **3ds Max**, **Corona Renderer**, and/or **V\-Ray**.
* Knowledge of **Enscape** and **AI\-based design tools** will be an added advantage.
* Ability to create detailed 2D drawings, 3D models, and high\-quality photorealistic renderings.
* Good understanding of interior design, materials, furniture detailing, and space planning.
* Excellent spoken and written **English communication skills**.
* **Requirements For Supervisors**
* Minimum **5 years of experience** in an interior design/execution firm.
* Ability to read and understand **2D drawings and site layouts**.
* Strong knowledge of interior finishing works, carpentry, civil, electrical, plumbing, and painting activities.
* Experience in coordinating with vendors, contractors, and labour teams.
* Ability to monitor site progress, quality, and timely project completion.
* Good communication skills in **Bengali, Hindi, and English**.
* Must be responsible, organized, and capable of handling projects independently.

Candidates with strong technical knowledge, creativity, and the ability to handle projects independently will be preferred.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Advance Power-Point & UI/UX Designer
description:
Job Summary



SAI is looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Advanced PowerPoint, Web \& UI/UX Designer** with excellent expertise in **Microsoft PowerPoint**, along with good knowledge of **Web Design and UI/UX Design**.


**Advanced PowerPoint design is a core and mandatory responsibility of this position.** Irrespective of the candidate's involvement in Web Design, UI/UX, marketing, product design, or any other project, he/she must be prepared to create, modify, redesign, and deliver professional PowerPoint presentations whenever required by the company.



The ideal candidate should be capable of transforming business ideas, product concepts, technical information, reports, dashboards, research, and raw content into visually compelling and professional presentations.



Web Design and UI/UX knowledge will be used to strengthen the candidate's overall design capability, but **PowerPoint presentation work will remain an essential part of the role.**



Mandatory PowerPoint Responsibility



The selected candidate must understand that **PowerPoint projects are compulsory for this position**.



Based on business requirements, management requests, client meetings, demonstrations, exhibitions, product launches, internal meetings, or other company activities, the employee may be required to create PowerPoint presentations at any time.



The candidate should therefore be comfortable taking complete ownership of a presentation project, including:


**Requirement**  **Content Understanding**  **Story Structure**  **Visual Concept**  **Slide Design**  **Graphics**  **Animation**  **Review**  **Final Presentation**



PowerPoint work should not be considered an occasional or secondary responsibility. It is a **regular and mandatory part of this role at SAI**.



Key Responsibilities


* Create professional, modern, and visually engaging PowerPoint presentations.
* Take complete ownership of PowerPoint projects assigned by the company.
* Be available to create or modify presentations whenever required for business purposes.
* Design executive presentations, product presentations, sales decks, client presentations, company profiles, proposals, reports, training materials, and internal presentations.
* Convert raw information, technical content, data, screenshots, and ideas into structured presentation stories.
* Convert text\-heavy and basic presentations into visually impressive professional presentations.
* Design product demonstration and technology concept presentations.
* Develop infographics, diagrams, workflows, timelines, process flows, charts, dashboards, and visual storytelling elements.
* Maintain consistency in typography, spacing, alignment, colors, branding, icons, and layouts.
* Create reusable PowerPoint templates and master slides.
* Work with Slide Master, custom layouts, themes, placeholders, and advanced formatting.
* Create professional animations, transitions, and interactive presentation experiences.
* Prepare presentations for senior management, customers, exhibitions, conferences, meetings, and product demonstrations.
* Understand the objective and audience of every presentation before starting the design.
* Work with management, product, technical, marketing, and other teams to collect information and convert it into presentation\-ready content.
